anvandarvillkor.title: Terms of Service
anvandarvillkor.body:
Terms of Service

Welcome to Beaver Store. By shopping with us you accept the following terms. We recommend that you read them carefully before making a purchase.

Company Information

Beaver Store is operated by Stonebite Ecom AB
Email: kundsupport@baverbutiken.se
Address: Stenkolsgatan 1B, 417 07 Göteborg, Sweden

NOTE: Are you shopping as a business customer?

Do you want to buy from us as a business? Please contact us before you buy.
We do not sell to businesses unless it involves resale in larger volumes, in which case you need to contact us before purchase to get an invoice. Otherwise, we refer you to use the order confirmation as your invoice / receipt

Ordering

When you place an order in our web shop, you receive an order confirmation by email. If anything is wrong in the order confirmation, please contact us immediately by email.

Prices

All prices are shown in your local currency. Customs duties and import fees may apply when the item is shipped from our warehouse abroad – see the shipping policy. We reserve the right to adjust prices when necessary and in the case of obvious typing errors.

Payment

We offer payment via the most common payment methods, including card payment (VISA, Mastercard), PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay.

Delivery

We always offer free shipping on all orders. Normal delivery time is 5–10 business days. Delivery time may vary depending on where you live and which carrier is used. We are not responsible for delays caused by the carrier.

Right to Change Your Mind & Returns

You have 14 days to change your mind. The product must be returned unused and in its original packaging. The customer pays the return shipping. If a return is approved, the amount is refunded within 14 days. Always contact us before you send an item back.

Complaints

If an item is defective or faulty, please contact us as soon as possible, and no later than 2 months after the defect was discovered. We follow the Swedish Consumer Sales Act for all complaints.

Liability

We accept no liability for indirect damage that may arise from the use of products bought from us. Nor do we accept liability for delays or problems beyond our control (force majeure).

Changes to the Terms

We reserve the right to change these terms at any time. The latest version is always published on our website.

om-oss.title: About Beaver Store
om-oss.body:
Beaver Store didn't start out as a store. It started in a garage, with cables that needed connecting, cable lugs that were missing and a pair of pliers that didn't work. The solution was a small quick connector that you simply push on. We named it the Beaver Connector, after Sweden's hardest-working builder.

Then came the Beaver Lamp, for anyone who tinkers when it's dark. And the Beaver Funnel, which stays put on the can when you refuel the lawn mower. Every time it was the same thing: an everyday item that ought to exist, but that nobody had made properly.

Today Beaver Store is a full store with over 200 products for the garage, the boat, the garden and camping. Think of that hardware store you like to wander around in, but online and with only the things that are actually worth having. Everything we bring in has to prove itself first. Whatever doesn't measure up gets cut.

Why a beaver?

The beaver builds, mends and fixes with whatever it has around it. It doesn't give up, and it does it in good spirits. That is exactly the feeling we want the store to have: gear for people who would rather fix things themselves than call someone.

What you can count on

  • Products that solve a real problem. Not things that just fill a shelf. Every product should make something in everyday life easier.
  • Tested before it earns a place. We bring in a lot and keep a little. Whatever doesn't measure up gets cut.
  • Prices that make sense. Good stuff shouldn't have to cost as much as a big brand.
  • Safe shopping. Free shipping, 14 days to change your mind and customer service by email.

Who we are

Beaver Store is run by Stonebite Ecom AB in Gothenburg. We are a small crew who find the products, test them, make the videos and answer the emails ourselves.

Do you have a question, an idea for a product that ought to exist, or did something not turn out the way you expected? Email kundsupport@baverbutiken.se. You can also track your parcel right here on the site. Thank you for shopping with us.

Axel, founder
